sections.text_helper: Section 61.6.14 "RTC timestamp date register (RTC_TSDR)" in chapter 61 (Real-time clock (RTC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3043.
sections.section_content:
The content of this register is valid only when TSF is set to 1 in RTC_SR. It is cleared when
TSF bit is reset.
This register can be protected against nonsecure access. Refer to Section61.3.4: RTC
secure protection modes.
This register can be protected against unprivileged access. Refer to Section61.3.5: RTC
privilege protection modes.
Address offset: 0x34
Backup domain reset value: 0x0000 0000
System reset: not affected
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:13 WDU[2:0]: Week day units
Bit 12 MT: Month tens in BCD format
Bits 11:8 MU[3:0]: Month units in BCD format
Bits 7:6 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 5:4 DT[1:0]: Date tens in BCD format
Bits 3:0 DU[3:0]: Date units in BCD format
